open BigOperators Real Nat

theorem qsm_ind_div_0 (n : ℕ) : 14 ∣ 5 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 11 ^ (n + 2) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨11 * k + 5 ^ (2 * n + 1), ?_⟩
    have h1 : (5:ℕ) ^ (2 * (n + 1) + 1) = 25 * 5 ^ (2 * n + 1) := by ring
    have h2 : (11:ℕ) ^ (n + 1 + 2) = 11 * 11 ^ (n + 2) := by ring
    rw [h1, h2]
    linarith

theorem qsm_ind_div_1 (n : ℕ) : 27 ∣ 8 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 10 ^ (n + 2) := by

lemma qsm_aux (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) : x ^ 2 / y ≥ 2 * x - y := by

  rw [ge_iff_le, div_add_div _ _ hb.ne' hc.ne', div_add_div _ _ (mul_pos hb hc).ne' ha.ne', le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]

theorem qsm_fib_identity_2 (n : ℕ) :
    (Nat.fib (n + 2) : ℤ) * Nat.fib n - (Nat.fib (n + 1) : ℤ) ^ 2 = (-1) ^ (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [Nat.fib_add_two]
  | succ k ih =>
    have h2 : (Nat.fib (k+2) : ℤ) = Nat.fib k + Nat.fib (k+1) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.fib_add_two
    have h1 : (Nat.fib (k+1+2) : ℤ) = Nat.fib (k+1) + Nat.fib (k+2) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.fib_add_two (n := k+1)
    show (Nat.fib (k+1+2) : ℤ) * Nat.fib (k+1) - (Nat.fib (k+2) : ℤ) ^ 2 = (-1) ^ (k+1+1)
    rw [h1, pow_succ]
    linear_combination (-1 : ℤ) * ih - (Nat.fib (k+2) : ℤ) * h2

theorem qsm_gcd_linear_0 (n : ℕ) : Nat.gcd (3 * n + 11) (14 * n + 51) = 1 := by
  have ha : Nat.gcd (3 * n + 11) (14 * n + 51) ∣ 3 * n + 11 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _
  have hb : Nat.gcd (3 * n + 11) (14 * n + 51) ∣ 14 * n + 51 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _
  have h1 : Nat.gcd (3 * n + 11) (14 * n + 51) ∣ 14 * (3 * n + 11) :=
    Dvd.dvd.mul_left ha 14
  have h2 : Nat.gcd (3 * n + 11) (14 * n + 51) ∣ 3 * (14 * n + 51) :=
    Dvd.dvd.mul_left hb 3
  have h3 : 14 * (3 * n + 11) = 3 * (14 * n + 51) + 1 := by ring
  rw [h3] at h1
  have h4 := (Nat.dvd_add_right h2).mp h1
  exact Nat.dvd_one.mp h4

import Mathlib

open BigOperators Real Nat

theorem qsm_no_rational_root_0 : ¬ ∃ q : ℚ, q ^ 3 = 13 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have h1 : ((q:ℝ))^3 = ((13:ℤ):ℝ) := by
    have : ((q^3 : ℚ):ℝ) = ((13:ℚ):ℝ) := by rw [hq]
    push_cast at this ⊢
    exact this
  have h2 : ¬ ∃ y : ℤ, (q:ℝ) = y := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [hy] at h1
    have h3 : y^3 = 13 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have h4 : y ≤ 2 ∨ 3 ≤ y := by omega
    rcases h4 with h | h
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 h) (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg (y+1)) (by norm_num : (0:ℤ) ≤ 3))]
    · have h5 : 0 ≤ y^2 + 3*y + 9 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 h) h5]
  exact Rat.not_irrational q (irrational_nrt_of_notint_nrt 3 13 h1 h2 (by norm_num))
